Basic Statistics

Fact: “Every day, 2.5 quintillion bytes of data are created—statistics help us make sense of it all.”“Did you know that 90% of the world’s data has been generated in the last two years? Understanding statistics is key to making sense of it all.”

Here are a few videos for you to gain an understanding of the data around us! 

A short video illustrating how statistics influence business decisions and everyday life.   How Data Shapes the World  

A short video showcasing real-world applications of statistics in business and decision-making. Why Statistics Matter in Business

Objectives

By the end of this module, you’ll be able to:

Grasp core statistical concepts (probability, distributions, sampling).

Learn to visualize data effectively for business insights.

Master data storytelling—transforming numbers into actionable insights.

Develop hands-on skills using Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva.

 

Recall of Prior Knowledge

“Think back to a time when you had to analyze numbers in a report or presentation. Did you rely on averages, percentages, or trends? How could statistical tools have made your analysis more effective?”A quick question or brief recap activity connecting to previous modules or known experiences.

 

Content
1. Why Learn Statistics?

Understanding data is crucial for decision-making, market analysis, and risk assessment in business. Whether you're launching a startup, optimizing a product, or analyzing trends, statistics provide the foundation for making informed decisions.

This module will help you:

(A) Grasp core statistical concepts (probability, distributions, sampling).

(B) Learn to visualize data effectively for business insights.

(C ) Master data storytelling—transforming numbers into actionable insights.

(D) Develop hands-on skills using Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva.

C. Data Story Telling

Numbers tell stories if you know how to tell them right!

A great business leader doesn’t just analyze data, they turn numbers into compelling, action-driven narratives! 

This week’s mission:

 Master the art of data storytelling

Create stunning visual reports using PowerPoint & Canva

Learn from the best in the industry

Real-Life Storytelling Example

3.  Hypothesis Testing Module (To Cover Z-tests & Confidence Intervals)

This module teaches how hypothesis testing helps validate business strategies and financial decisions using statistical tools. 

Topics Covered:

Formulating Hypotheses: Null and alternative hypotheses.

Statistical Significance: p-values, confidence intervals, and z-tests.

Business Applications: A/B testing, marketing performance evaluation, financial risk analysis.

Video Resource: Hypothesis Testing for Beginners
